correctness.rationale: At z=0 the absorbing generator is triangular with positive diagonals 1..n, ensuring analytic solution. Differentiating first-step recurrence gives T1(A)=u_k I(A)+v_k C(A); for the quadratic term pure-death subset averaging and exact hypergeometric p_rs count internal-cut, cut², colony-neighbor² and colony-degree pair contributions. Algebra reduces all second-order graph terms to m, C(m,2), W(G). Exact sign follows from rational c_{n,1},c_{n,2}, harmonic lower bound and strict positive-coefficient symbolic polynomial in t=k-3,r=n-k-1; independently verified full symbolic polynomial identity, checked star/path coefficients (25/12,29/24,11/16) and (25/12,29/24,61/144), gap 19/72. A finite graph census cannot prove all n.

originality.rationale: Holme–Tupikina compute exact finite contact-process extinction times on connected graphs through eight vertices, so all such particular graph instances and their Taylor coefficients are implicitly covered, including the n4 witness. Mountford et al. study large-graph metastable extinction at fixed infection rates, a different limit. The candidate’s surviving added claim is the all-finite-n structural second-order coefficient controlled only by edges/wedges and strict w_n positivity; finite tables do not entail the all-size theorem. Residual risk of an unlocated general perturbative formula.

Comparison is only for sufficiently small graph-pair-dependent z, not finite-rate ranking or uniform n.
